title: SYNTHETIC — Cedar source-detail demo
body:
This is fictional evaluation data, not a real release.
Cedar converts a change list into a review checklist.
It is available only to invited U.S. teams with administrator approval.
It costs $0.20 per completed checklist; larger-team pricing is unannounced.
Each session is limited to five checklists. A person must review the result; it cannot merge code.
